title: Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau to visit Paraguay and Argentina
excerpt: The official will lead a trade delegation to Asunción and meet with government leaders in Buenos Aires from October 19 to 26.
bodyHtml:
The US State Department announced on October 16, 2026, that Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau will travel to Asunción, Paraguay, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, from October 19 to 26. Assistant Secretary of State for Western Hemisphere Affairs Juan Pablo Segura will accompany the Deputy Secretary during the trip.

In Asunción, Deputy Secretary Landau will lead a trade delegation of U.S. companies to explore investment opportunities in Paraguay. He is also scheduled to meet with senior Paraguayan government officials to discuss trade, investment, regional security, and transnational crime.

During his visit to Buenos Aires, the Deputy Secretary will meet with senior Argentine government officials and private sector leaders. The meetings will focus on advancing economic growth, increasing U.S. investment, and strengthening security cooperation following the launch of the Andes-Atlantic Corridor.
